Hi Samira —

Sorry we missed each other for today’s discovery. I know schedules get tight; just wanted to check in and offer two quick paths to reconnect so we can keep momentum on your evaluation of Redwood Inference: 

1) Fast path — book a 15-minute slot (self-serve): https://cal.redwood.com/lauren/15
2) Async path — I can send a 2–3 bullet recap + tailored one-pager if you prefer email (I attached our one-pager).

If it helps, I have availability Tue 11/23 10:00–10:30 PT or Wed 11/24 1:00–1:30 PT. If neither works, feel free to share 2 windows that do and I’ll do the rest.

Agenda for a 15-min discovery: 1) quick context on BrightLane goals, 2) how you’d use inference (latency/throughput/region needs), 3) next steps & folks to loop in. I’ve attached a short agenda and a one-pager for quick context.

If you prefer me to capture notes and next steps and share asynchronously, say the word and I’ll send immediately.

Thanks —
Lauren Bishop
